findings.title: Blank stored authority gets default pinned on edit
findings.problem: In getInitialCredentialValues, stored values that are blank are filtered out before merging over the defaults. With oauth_authority now carrying a dynDefault, editing a saved oauth_azure email credential whose authority is blank pre-fills the backend default, and saving persists it.
findings.impact: Narrow trigger: only editing a previously saved Email OAuth credential with a blank authority. The pinned value equals the backend's own fallback today, so behavior is unchanged until the default changes; the user can clear the field. Same merge behavior already applies to other dynDefault fields such as url.
findings.recommendation: Confirm that showing and persisting the default when editing a blank saved authority is intended; if not, skip dynamic defaults for fields stored blank when editing.
